provides: index.html at the repository root with doctype, lang, charset, viewport and title
styles.css at the repository root, already linked from index.html
scripts/check.mjs validating index.html structure and local links
npm test runs node --test (place tests as test/**/*.test.mjs, node:test + node:assert, no extra dependencies)
npm run check runs scripts/check.mjs and then the tests
ui-routes.json at the root with the default ["/"]: a JSON array of absolute route paths captured by the browser (keep this exact format)
